title: Bike counts and weather, Heidelberg and Mannheim, 2025 (cleaned, AI-ready)
description: Daily bicycle counts from 30 Eco-Counter sites in Heidelberg and Mannheim for 2025, cleaned and joined with daily weather from DWD station 05906 Mannheim and calendar features (weekday, weekend, Baden-Wuerttemberg public holidays). Missing days and sensor outages are kept as NULL with flags, never as 0. Built for analysing and forecasting daily bike traffic.
version: 1.1 (Zenodo release v1.1: 2025 data, Tableau = Python, Jan 2026 re-run)

creator.name: Data Management Group 07, SRH University of Applied Sciences Heidelberg

contact_point: Keshav Sain (data steward, FAIR and governance lead)

licence.note: The product keeps the licence of the bike count source. Weather data is CC BY 4.0 (DWD). Both require attribution.

attribution: Bicycle count data: MobiData BW / NVBW, Datenlizenz Deutschland - Namensnennung 2.0. Weather data: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD), CC BY 4.0.

provenance.cleaning_log: docs/cleaning_log_2025.md (rows before and after each step)

known_limitations: Weather is from one station (Mannheim) and is also used for Heidelberg.
bikes_in and bikes_out are empty for 2 sites that only report a total.
The counter operator can change the counter setup without notice.
In weekly_counts.csv use valid_days to judge partial weeks (bikes_total is NULL when valid_days = 0).

Counter B38. RI. AUS (Mannheim) counts about 4-12 bikes/day until August 2025 and about 1,000+/day from September (level shift, likely counter reconfiguration). Exclude this site before September 2025 when training a model.
